extDesc.message: Translate manga on any page with your own DeepSeek, Gemini or OpenAI-compatible key. Finds bubbles, wipes text, letters it in.

actionTitle.message: Translate what's on screen (press again to restore)

toastNoKey.message: No API key yet: right-click the extension icon → Options

toastDone.message: Translated $n$ lines in $s$ s ($d$). Turn the page or press again to restore.

optSub.message: Press Alt+Shift+J (or click the icon) to translate what's on screen; turn the page, scroll or press again to restore. Your key is stored only in this browser.

optThinking.message: Let the model think before answering

optThinkingHint.message: Off is much faster (about 2 s per page with DeepSeek). On takes 10+ s per page and is rarely more accurate.

toastNoCustom.message: Custom provider not set up yet: right-click the extension icon → Options, fill in the URL and model, then Save

optCuBaseHint.message: The part before /chat/completions, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 · https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 · https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 · http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama). Chrome asks once for access to this one site when you press Test or Save.

optCuKey.message: API key (leave empty for a local server)

optCuModelHint.message: The model must read images (a vision model). Press Test to list what the server offers.

optBadBase.message: Enter a URL that starts with https:// or http://

optPermDenied.message: Access to $o$ was not allowed, so the extension can't reach it

optOkCustom.message: Connected, $n$ models: $m$. Pick one that reads images.
